Diagnosis.Molecular Markers: ER positive (>95%), PR positive (<5%), HER2 negative (by FISH), Ki67 44%

Additional Comments: The patient is a 32-year-old female with a history of a genetic mutation in the ATM gene (c1109dup (p.Tyr370*) heterozygous) identified through the Myriad myRisk panel due to a family history of breast cancer. She has a clinical T2NX ER+/PR-/HER2 negative left breast cancer, with a Mammaprint indicating high risk. Imaging and biopsy results have shown an 8mm grade 2 invasive ductal carcinoma in the left breast, with multiple lymph nodes in the left axilla, though FNAs of these nodes have been benign. A bilateral breast MRI revealed a 2.5 cm x 2.2 cm x 2.3 cm mass in the left breast and a 9 mm fibroadenoma in the right breast. Radiation oncology has recommended mastectomy over breast-conserving surgery due to her ATM mutation. The patient is also aware that she will receive at least five years of adjuvant hormonal therapy post-surgery.
